about: Builds maplibre-gl-js from src. Its generated sources are not in git, so three generators run first. The Unicode data comes from the npm release, which saves running its generator, unless the generator differs from the release's. The generator then runs too. The stylesheet comes from the npm release, because its generator cannot run in a browser. The files under dist stand in for the bundles, so that the example pages in test/examples run as they are. The worker is a module next to the source that looks for it. In a comparison, the page of a demo keeps the maps of both sides on the same camera.
template: // Lets livebranch keep the cameras of two compared pages the same. Each map offers the views that
// input gives it and shows the views of the other side. A move is the user's when maplibre names
// its input, or when it starts right after input on the page, as a single turn of the wheel zooms
// without naming it. The maps are found through their events, which every version fires through
// the same method. Before version 4 the package has only a default export.
const MapClass = (maplibre as any).Map ?? (maplibre as any).default?.Map;
for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'pointermove', 'wheel', 'keydown', 'touchstart']) window.addEventListener(type, mark, {capture: true, passive: true});
const index: number = sync.follow((view: object) => map.jumpTo(view));
map.on('movestart', (event: any) => { driven = Boolean(event.originalEvent) || performance.now() - lastInput < 300; });
const view: Record<string, unknown> = {center: map.getCenter().toArray(), zoom: map.getZoom(), bearing: map.getBearing(), pitch: map.getPitch()};
